name: Women’s full-time, year-round median earnings as a share of men’s
source: Census Reporter API, republishing U.S. Census Bureau ACS 2024 5-year table B20017
notes: Captured API response identifies ACS 2020–2024 5-year, Carmel-by-the-Sea place 16000US0611250, B20017 title Median Earnings in the Past 12 Months by Sex by Work Experience, universe population 16+ with earnings. Male full-time/year-round median earnings are $109,800 (MOE $44,124); female are $100,313 (MOE $35,400), in 2024 inflation-adjusted dollars. Calculation 100,313/109,800×100=91.35%, rounded to 91.4%. Both margins are large relative to estimates; no ratio MOE has been computed, so confidence is low. Census Reporter republishes ACS as a long-running nonprofit data service (tier 3); official Census API endpoint failed during this pass.
